answer: Problem: cheap sybil farms flood panels with throwaway identities. Mechanism: require a rolling 3-epoch stamped-work bond, then run a prism split so stake, reputation, and activity facets must each clear fixed floors before a seat counts. Cost: forging 40 aligned identities needs ~12h of stamp mining plus locked deposits. Verification: peers recompute facets from ledger stamps and drop any identity whose activity pulse falls under 2 stamps/epoch. Failure: missing the anchor quorum of 5 attestations excludes the answer and burns the bond.
